query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `streaming_activity` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `trackId` int NOT NULL,
  `artistId` int NOT NULL,
  `durationSeconds` int NOT NULL,
  `completionPercentage` int NOT NULL,
  `sessionId` varchar(64) NULL,
  `ipAddress` varchar(45) NULL,
  `device` varchar(100) NULL,
  `isSuspicious` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `streaming_activity_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  INDEX `streaming_activity_user_id_idx` (`userId`),
  INDEX `streaming_activity_track_id_idx` (`trackId`),
  INDEX `streaming_activity_artist_id_idx` (`artistId`),
  INDEX `streaming_activity_created_at_idx` (`createdAt`)
);
